input.title: Reversed sorting order of Underline and Strikethrough
input.body: ``` - A - 2 - Text - B - C - D ``` ## Step to Reproduce 1. Add Bold to Thought A 2. Add Underline to Thought B 3. Add Strikethrough to Thought C 4. Add Italic to Thought D 5. Sort them as Alphabetically - Descending ## Current behavior Sorting order are as follow: 1. Bold 2. Italic 3. Strikethrough 4. Underline 5. Numeric 6. Unformatted Text ## Expected behavior Descending Sorting order should be as follow: 1. Bold 2. Italic 3. Underline 4. Strikethrough 5. Numeric 6. Unformatted Text
